# flowda Agent Skills

> Agent Skills and a hosted MCP server that teach an AI agent to use the flowda
> developer API: fetch a page, search the web, enumerate a site's URLs, run a
> maintained site template, and monitor pages for change. Six skills, twenty MCP
> tools, one API key.

## Start here

- [Agent onboarding](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/docs/agent-onboarding.md): the steps to install, connect the MCP server and verify with `flowda_account`.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/docs/install.md): per-client commands (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Continue, local stdio).
- [README](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/README.md): what the pack is, the install matrix and the 30-second quick start.

## Skills

- [flowda](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda/SKILL.md): router — which capability to use, what it costs, how failures and scopes work.
- [flowda-extract](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda-extract/SKILL.md): fetch one known page as markdown, links, raw HTML or clean HTML.
- [flowda-search](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda-search/SKILL.md): search the web, news, shopping or scholar indexes; billed per result.
- [flowda-map](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda-map/SKILL.md): enumerate a site's URLs before extracting.
- [flowda-template](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda-template/SKILL.md): run a maintained Amazon or Walmart extraction template.
- [flowda-watch](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/skills/flowda-watch/SKILL.md): recurring monitors, webhook callbacks, check history and diffs.

## MCP server and API

- MCP endpoint: `https://mcp.flowda.ai/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; no SSE).
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer flw_<env>_<key_id>_<secret>`; create the
  key in the flowda console. There is no anonymous tier.
- Developer API and documentation: <https://docs.flowda.ai>
- OpenAPI document: <https://openapi.flowda.ai/v1/openapi.json>

## Contract and maintenance

- Contract snapshot: `spec/openapi.snapshot.json`; field tables under
  `skills/flowda/references/params/` are generated from it.
- [Maintenance guide](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/docs/authoring.md): sources of truth, regeneration, validation and release gates.
- [Evals](https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills/blob/main/evals/README.md): runnable behaviour checks for routing, failure reporting and cost discipline.
- Repository: <https://github.com/Flowda-Ai/agent-skills>
